IfcOpenShell JS/WASM — tutorials

Runnable index.html + app.js chapters for this package. They call init(), load schema and geometry plugins, then use File, open, and ifcopenshell/geom.

From src/ts, run python -m http.server 4173 (or node ifcopenshell-js/examples/serve.mjs). Pages load ifcopenshell and WASM from the jsDelivr CDN. They do not run from file://. Notes: TUTORIAL.md · threejs.html
